newsitem.title: THAILAND: Government Savings Bank buys Thai Airways shares.
newsitem.headline: Government Savings Bank buys Thai Airways shares.

text.p: Thailand's state-owned Government Savings Bank bought 187.5 million shares, or 13.39 percent of Thai Airways Plc on July 7 at 16 baht, Thai Airways said in a statement on Wednesday.
Thailand's Ministry of Finance in February ordered Thai Airways, in which the ministry retains a 79.46 percent stake, to sell 18 percent of its outstanding shares to the state bank.

It ordered the airline to invest three billion baht from the sale in the debt-ridden Don Muang Tollway Co, which operates the expressway running from downtown Bangkok to the city's international airport.
Under the conditions of the arrangement, Thai Airways must buy back its shares within five years.
The sale of shares is due in two tranches, the next of which is planned at 10 baht per share. Securities One Plc handled the transaction, the statement said.
In February, former Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said the total sale should reduce the Ministry's stake in the carrier to 75 percent.
